items.title: Chính quyền Mỹ đề xuất áp đặt mức thuế quan mới đối với 14 đối tác thương mại lớn
items.summary: Tổng thống Mỹ Donald Trump ngày 25/11 một lần nữa làm gia tăng căng thẳng thương mại toàn cầu khi đề xuất áp thuế quan mới đối với các đối tác thương mại lớn, trong đó có Trung Quốc. Động thái này cho thấy ông Trump không có ý định từ bỏ chính sách thương mại của mình, bất chấp những thất bại của đảng Cộng hòa trong cuộc bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ tại Mỹ.

items.title: Cách nào huy động 6,4 triệu tỷ đồng đầu tư toàn xã hội?
items.summary: Để đạt mục tiêu tăng trưởng GDP từ 10% trở lên trong năm 2027, Việt Nam cần huy động khoảng 6,4 triệu tỷ đồng vốn đầu tư toàn xã hội. Trong đó, khu vực tư nhân được kỳ vọng đóng góp hơn một nửa, đặt ra yêu cầu phát triển các kênh dẫn vốn ngoài tín dụng ngân hàng và thu hút mạnh hơn dòng vốn quốc tế.

items.title: S&P considers Nvidia credit downgrade over governance and ‘key man’ risks
items.summary: The credit rating agency may lower Nvidia's credit rating to AA-, the fourth-highest rating.

items.title: FCC approves SpaceX plan to put AI data centers in space
items.summary: The FCC dismissed some of the key concerns raised by opponents, including potential threats to scientific research, because the agency determined they fell outside its regulatory authority.

items.title: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work
items.summary: OpenAI will introduce a single usage meter across ChatGPT as it combines the Chat and Work experiences.

items.title: Jensen Huang broke Nvidia’s code of conduct, and his employees may not forget it
items.summary: Most codes of conduct serve as a reflection of corporate culture. In Nvidia's case, that could have consequences.

items.title: The canceled Tesla Cybertruck is the fastest-selling used truck in America
items.summary: The Tesla Cybertruck was the fastest-selling used truck last month, averaging just 39.1 days on the market compared to 65.5 days for trucks overall.

items.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei calls accusations of surrendering human control to AI ‘absurd’
items.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei pushes back against rivals’ accusations that he favors surrendering human agency to AI, even as leading AI companies increasingly automate their own research and model development.

items.title: 1Password said hackers broke into its internal systems, but customer passwords are safe
items.summary: The password manager maker said an attacker gained access to an employee's corporate account and took some information about customers.

items.title: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York
items.summary: New York has banned AI chatbot toys for five years as new research from Common Sense Media reveals troubling safety failures, including exposure to inappropriate content and risks to emotional development.

items.title: DOJ accuses former cyber executive of defrauding ransomware victims by secretly paying hackers
items.summary: U.S. prosecutors accused the former executive of defrauding victims of ransomware by paying the hackers, charging victims more, and pocketing the difference.

items.title: Character.AI’s plan to auction off users’ private chats challenged by state AGs
items.summary: The proposed Character.ai bankruptcy sale includes sensitive personal data from more than 21 million U.S. accounts, including 2.1 million registered to minors, the state AGs said.

items.title: X’s latest update for creators focuses on vertical video
items.summary: As short-form video ramps up in popularity, X's new creation tools are part of its effort to compete with YouTube and Instagram.

items.title: WhatsApp now lets you schedule messages in group and individual chats
items.summary: Users can schedule messages from 10 minutes later to after 14 days.

items.title: South Korea's Kospi leads gains as tech rebound lifts Asia markets
items.summary: Japan's Nikkei 225 rose 1.21% in early trade, while the Topix edged 0.71% higher. Australia's S&P/ASX 200 was up 0.15%.

items.title: SpaceX, Musk pledge to donate a share each to active Trump Accounts
items.summary: SpaceX said it will donate one share of the company's class A stock to every active Trump Account, and CEO Elon Musk would match it.

items.title: Saudi national in OpenAI bugging case is out on bond after DOJ tries to block release
items.summary: Abdulrahman Alfozan, a former OpenAI engineer, is expected to be fitted with an ankle monitor, his attorney, David Rizk, previously told CNBC.

items.title: Nvidia sellers seek new buyers as U.S. curbs China AI chip access, sources tell CNBC
items.summary: Nvidia GPU sellers are seeking new buyers after new U.S. rules tightened remote access to advanced AI chips for China-linked customers

items.title: Tech stocks sink but close well off the lows, Anthropic struggles to rebound above IPO price
items.summary: Nvidia and other AI-linked stocks fell as investors weighed AI spending, inflation and higher-rate risks.

items.summary: Nothing is showing off a much more detailed look at its upcoming AI earbuds ahead of their December 8th release.
